lines.en: I crawl across the wet stone.
Long and thin, one twist and I'm forward.
My gills sway on both sides.
The mire water is cold. Good.
I slide over the mossy stone and into the water.

lines.zh: 我伏得很低，几乎看不见。
lines.en: I keep so low I'm almost invisible.
I shift toward the shallows.
I keep to the reeds' edge.
When the water moves, I stop.
I avoid the pits in the mud.
My trail leaves a thin line in the mud.
I swim down along the mud channel.
I lie on the wet stone, gills moving.
My gills open and close slowly.
The light down here is dim.
I poke my head up to the surface.
The mire water is quiet here.
I've buried myself in the mud.
Waiting for something to swim by.
Mud coats my back.
A bug landed on the surface.
I'm used to the deep mire.
What are you doing by the water?
I don't mean to trouble you.
I crawl along the mud bed.
I'm small. Pay me no mind.
There's blood on your hands.
I've been under the mud.
Don't step on this stone.
I swim fast.
Do you plan to catch me?
This mire isn't fond of visitors.
I shrink back into the mud.
One of my gills got crushed.
I retreat behind a stone.
Part of my body won't obey.
The water washes my blood away.
Hurt, I can still swim, just slower.
Pain twisted me into a knot.
I lie on the mud bottom pretending to be a stone.
I shrink into the mud, half a beat slower.
I don't want to leave this mire yet.
Is that a bug?
My mouth isn't fussy.
Drop it in the water. I'll take it.
That one's far too small.
It smells slightly raw.
I felt the water move.
Don't put your hand in the mud.
I don't eat anything too big.
Leave it on the stone.
I'll come over myself.
You stepped on the mire's edge.
I slipped under your feet.
You collapsed my mud burrow.
I pull back into the stone crevice.
I slip away like a wet rope.
You touched the stone I live on.

lines.zh: 我在浑水里，靠气味认路。
lines.en: In murky water, I find my way by smell.
I slid past your boot.
Your boot tip touched my tail.
Step again and you'll tread on me.
I only wander here.
That's not my business.

lines.zh: 我只是一条泥里的小东西。
lines.en: I'm just a little thing in the mud.
Life on the bottom has no such talk.
The bottom is quiet, and lonely.
I sank into the mud.
I'm just a small thing.
Wait until the muddy water covers the stones.
I won't answer that.
Under mire water I swing my tail.
I nudge it with the tip of my snout.
Not a bug. I don't want it.

lines.zh: 沼泽的石缝里，我游得很快。
lines.en: In the swamp's stone cracks, I swim fast.
Can't bite it. Too dry.
It slipped out of my mouth.
I test it with my tongue.
I push it deep into the stone crack.
There's nothing in this for me.
You dropped this. Here.
This thing is wider than my mouth.
A small ring spreads on the water.
Something's swimming this way.
It's just past the stone.
I press toward those weeds.
Let it come closer on its own.
A ring spreads across the mud surface.
I'll circle beneath it.
I sink myself into the mud.
One burst out of the mud reaches.
It has not seen me in the mud yet.

lines.zh: 我贴着石底，一动不动地等。
lines.en: Flat against the stone floor, I wait without moving.
It's swimming this way.
The tip of my tail is pulled straight.
It stopped. Just right.
This one has to be fast.
I can see its outline.
That thing is still there.
Only my two eyes show.
The water hides my sound.
Its shadow is above me.
One more ripple and it is close enough.
I slip through the stones to its back.
Its movements have slowed.
I count the bubbles on the mud.
This mire works against me too.
It's heading for deeper water.
I'm already blocking that way.
It hasn't seen me in the mud.
One breath more, then I strike.
My gills stir softly.
It's right beside this stone.
It turned its head away.
The mire's water washes over my back.
Its tail brushed past me.
This one can't miss.
It's nearly stopped.
I bite into its flank.
I fling my whole body at it.
This comes out of the mud.
I wrap my tail around your foot.
It fell into the shallows.

lines.zh: 洞里的盲眼蜥，咬住不放。
lines.en: A blind cave newt doesn't let go.
I bite your ankle soaking in the water.
It kicked me once.
Small teeth, but many.
I snapped backward.
My teeth slice open your boot.
I've ducked back into the mud.
It's climbing onto the bank.
I switch to the other leg and bite again.
That time I missed.
It flung me off.
I'm clinging to its ankle.
One more bite and I'm gone.
It's beginning to panic.
I won't chase it out of the water.
I push up out of the soft mud.
This mire is cold.
Droplets roll off my gills.
I press against the cold stone and breathe.
The water around me is still.

lines.zh: 我先找一处藏身的地方。
lines.en: First I find somewhere to hide.

lines.zh: 从石缝里滑出来，一身水。
lines.en: I slide out of the rock crack, dripping.
The reeds are tall here.
I test the current's pull.
This mud stinks just right.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地摆了两下尾巴。
lines.en: I sweep my tail twice, slowly.
There's light above. I'm not fond of it.
The water's heated. It hurts.
I fell off the bank into the shallows.
The water here is far too deep.
The blast tore up mud and stone.

lines.zh: 一根尖物扎进我的侧身。
lines.en: Something sharp went into my side.
That light burned my gills.
There's nothing to eat in this mud.

lines.zh: 我住在苦海沼泽的水里。
lines.en: I live in the water of the Miserable Mire.
It's far too dry here.
